fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Resume Written in Chinese or in English * 2. High school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 4. Passport photos Two recent passport-sized photos of the applicant * 5. Photocopy of valid passport or residence permit With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 6. English Language Proficiency Certificate * 7. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -You can apply without CSCA for 2026 intake. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Aged between 18-50 with good health and hold a senior high school graduation diploma at least, and passing the professional basic examination and oral Chinese interview. 2.Language Requirements: Applicants who choose the English-taught courses are required to fulfill one of the following criteria: TOEFL (PBT) 550 / TOEFL (iBT) 80 / IELTS 6.0 or equivalent. Applicants from English speaking countries or last degree courses was taught in English are exempted from the above language requirements. Applicants from the partner institutions are exempted from the above language requirements with the letter of proof which equivalent to CEFR B2. 3.CSCA requirements: The test includes two subjects: Professional Chinese and Mathematics. (1) Professional Chinese The Professional Chinese examination offers two tracks: Liberal Arts Chinese and Science Chinese. Applicants for undergraduate programs taught in Chinese at our university are required to select Liberal Arts Chinese. 1. Applicants seeking undergraduate education taught entirely in English are not required to take the specialized Chinese proficiency test; 2. Applicants for the majors in Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages, Chinese Language, or Chinese Language and Literature may apply for an exemption from the Chinese subject test if they can provide a valid HSK Level 4 score report. (2) Foundational Subjects Mathematics (Required): Mathematics serves as a key assessment of applicants' foundational academic abilities and logical reasoning skills. It is a mandatory subject for all applicants regardless of their chosen major. (3) Test Language Both Mathematics and Chinese offer examination papers in Chinese and English. Applicants may select the language of their examination paper based on the language of instruction required for their program.
